question: Do you have anything you eat or drink when writing Re: Zero?
answer: I drink Monster Energy. When I’m really out of time and am under pressure with deadlines, I try to deal with it using Monster Energy. However, one of my friends, Mikami Teren, ended up with a caffeine overdose. A heavy headache and not being able to drink caffeine would be a problem. So I try to use that reflection and control it. I rarely drink Monster Energy, only when I really need to drink it.
